Postdoctoral Researcher, Photonics for Quantum Postdoc in quantum integrated photonics: develop QPICs, wafer-scale process & EO characterization, build projects/funding, publish & supervise; work with academia/industry. 3-year term.

Post-doctoral researcher in Construction Business Postdoc: study digital & green transition in construction/real estate—digital twins, data interoperability, material passports, decision support. Lahti (Finland), hybrid; 2-year.

ENGINEER/POST-DOC POSITION OFFER : in Stretchable Electronics & Optics for Artificial Skin – 12 months Postdoc/ingénieur R&D (12 mois) : guides d’onde optiques étirables pour peau artificielle (pression/temp.), intégration LED/photodiodes, cleanroom, Python.

Post-doctoral researcher in Building Services Postdoc researching HVAC/automation for sustainable, user-safe buildings: demand control, energy efficiency, IAQ/comfort. Lahti, Finland (hybrid). 2 yrs. €4.3–5k/mo.

Post-doctoral researcher in Urban Physics on Heat Waves and Air Quality Postdoc: high-fidelity CFD/building-energy modelling of urban heat waves & air pollution, validated with on-site measurements; publish, proposals, supervise. Lahti, Finland (hybrid).

KAUST Global Fellowship Program - Postdoctoral Fellowship (Call 2027) 3-year postdoctoral fellowship in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia: lead independent research (Food/Water/Energy/Health/AI/Red Sea). $75k stipend + $20–40k/yr research, benefits.

Postdoc position in CO2 electrocatalysis under realistic conditions Postdoc on CO2 electroreduction: build modular reactors, run operando electrochem/spectroscopy & synchrotron studies to uncover degradation and boost electrode durability.

Postdoctoral Laser Scientist 3-year postdoc in Hamburg: develop automated laser beam-shaping & quality metrics for European XFEL; Python control/analysis, optics/beam transport; AI/RL alignment a plus.

Postdoctoral Fellow / Process Engineer for metal assisted chemical etching Join SNSF ABSOLUTE project to optimize silicon MacEtch for high-aspect microstructures. Cleanroom work on 4” wafers; photolithography, deposition, SEM/metrology; publish & present.

AGBS - Postdoctoral Researcher in advanced fertilizers and sustainable nutrient delivery systems for agriculture Postdoc to develop biodegradable biopolymer/biochar nutrient carriers from waste; materials characterization (FTIR/SEM/BET), controlled NPK release & greenhouse trials for drought soils.

Postdoc in atom probe tomography for sustainable metals 2-year postdoc in atom probe tomography for sustainable metallic alloys. Do specimen prep, APT acquisition/reconstruction & analysis; collaborate, publish. Stockholm.

Postdoc in Stochastic PDEs for Transport Networks 2-year postdoc in PRONTO: model public transport networks via stochastic PDEs. Interdisciplinary applied math/control/data science; publish and present, optional teaching.

Postdoc In Atomic-Scale Processing for Future Chips and Energy 3 postdoc roles in atomic-scale materials processing (ALD) for photonics, AI-driven workflows or energy storage. 2-year full-time in Eindhoven; supervise students & publish.

Postdoctoral Researcher – Tactile Sensing for Dexterous Manipulation Lead design/fabrication of compact multi-axis tactile sensors for dexterous robotic hands; integrate and benchmark closed-loop control; co-supervise students; publish top robotics work.

Postdoc in gears - manufacturing to performance Postdoc: study how manufacturing and geometry/surface variations affect gear efficiency, wear and life. Run FZG rig experiments, surface/geometry metrology; explore new materials and lubrication.

Postdoc in X-ray and neutron characterization of metals for AM Develop in-/ex-situ synchrotron & neutron methods at PETRA III (P21.2) to study laser/e-beam processed metals for AM/welding; analyze microstructure, phase changes & properties.

Postdoc in Multidisciplinary Aircraft Design and Aerodynamic Integration Postdoc advancing multidisciplinary aircraft design & aerodynamic integration: conceptual design, MDO, high‑fidelity CFD; explore unconventional, electric/hydrogen concepts with academia & industry.

Postdoctoral researcher in learning, control, and games 2-year postdoc on closed-loop learning, control & games; develop mathematical/computational methods for AI/human decision-makers interacting with dynamical environments.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Bioelectrochemical CO₂ Conversion and Electrocatalysis 24‑month industrial postdoc developing durable electrocatalysts and methanogenic bioelectrochemical reactors for CO₂‑to‑methane conversion; 12 mo university + 12 mo industry.

Postdoctoral researcher in Human-Robot Interaction 2-year postdoc: build universal, context-adaptive robot communication; run field & lab user studies, develop theory/models, mentor junior researchers. On-site in Gothenburg.

Post doc in hydrogen infrastructure in energy systems Model hydrogen demand, production, distribution & storage in a high‑resolution Nordic energy system model. Techno‑economic analysis, interdisciplinary EU collaboration; some teaching/supervision.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Circular Chemistry and Green Hydrogen Electrocatalysis 12-month postdoc: build circular electrocatalysts from recycled materials for green H2 and electrolyser dev; network with industry, run experiments, co-write funding proposals/papers.

Scientist (f/m/div) in the Area Resource-Efficient Controlled Environment Horticulture Postdoc role developing sensor- & model-based (AI/Digital Twin) strategies to optimize resource-efficient greenhouse/indoor crops. 3+3 yrs, TV-L E13, 32h+ / up to 50% remote.

Two Postdoctoral Researchers in Memristor Materials and Devices 2 postdoc tracks: memristor crossbar fabrication/reliability or perovskite quantum-dot nanomaterials for memristive devices. Strong experimental microfab or synthesis skills needed.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Multiphysics Modelling of High-Temperature Superconductor Quench Protection Develop and validate FEM/multiphysics models of quench behavior in YBCO HTS tapes/coils; simulate current diverters, propose safer architectures, publish results. 2-year postdoc.

Postdoc in Modeling Large Scale Effects of Electrification of Powertrains in Road-based Freight Model system-level impacts of electric/hybrid trucks on freight (grid, energy, emissions, costs). Apply dynamic systems, optimal control & stats; publish, teach, collaborate.

SUSMAT - 2 Post-Doctoral Fellow Positions: Development of Multifunctional Hydrogels for Agricultural Applications (2 positions) Opportunity for postdocs with experience in hydrogel formulation, polymer processing, and porous materials to develop bio-based hydrogels for agriculture in a collaborative, international project.

Postdoc position on redox-targeted flow batteries Develop PFAS-free solid booster composites for redox-targeted flow batteries; optimize morphology, in-flow UV-Vis diagnostics, 3D-print reactor prototypes; validate in lab flow cells.

Postdoctors in Nuclear Engineering 2-year postdoc: research thermohydraulics & safety of water/lead-cooled SMRs; analyze and support design of large-scale experimental facilities in Stockholm/Oskarshamn.

Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Mechanical and railway engineering) 2-year postdoc researching monitoring/mitigation of railway wheel out-of-roundness. Use vibration data, FE & multibody dynamics; lab + real-train testing; supervise students.

Postdoc in Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Systems 5 postdoc openings: research human-in-the-loop autonomous systems—adaptive coordination & user expectations; build prototypes/robot experiments, publish, supervise students. Full-time 2 yrs, on-site Gothenburg.

Post-doc Research Position: Nanofabrication for emitting devices Applications Postdoc in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia: nanofabrication of LED/laser diodes (GaN/oxides); cleanroom e-beam lithography/deposition, sputtering; competitive pay, housing & benefits.

Postdoc Positions: Origins of Irreversibility Three postdoc posts (math/theoretical physics or history) studying origins of entropy, randomness, chaos & irreversibility. 2-year contract, €3,706–5,760/month.

AGBS - Postdoctoral Researcher in Molecular Plant Physiology Join our Plant Stress Physiology team to study molecular mechanisms in plant responses to stress. Requires Ph.D., molecular biology skills, and publication record.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Metabolic Regulation of Inflammation Postdoc to dissect how metabolism rewires inflammatory signaling in human white adipocytes using perturbation, protein/chromatin assays, microscopy and metabolic phenotyping. Solna.

Postdoctoral Researcher / Project Researcher Fixed Term Position (Mathematics) Fixed-term postdoc/project researcher in analytic number theory (2027–2028). Independent research; strong research plan required. Salary ~€3.7–4.6k/mo (postdoc).

Postdoc in Optical Manipulation and Single-Particle Nanosensing Postdoc: develop optical tweezers and plasmonic nanoparticle single-particle nanosensing; build instrumentation, analyze data, study interactions in complex media.

Postdoc in Machine Learning and Surrogate Modelling Work at the interface of machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and computational biomechanics to develop real-time probabilistic surrogate models for neurosurgical guidance systems.

Postdoc in proteomics study of heterologous expression and PTMs of casein in bacterial hosts 2-year postdoc: use MS-based proteomics to detect/optimize casein PTMs (phosphorylation required; glycosylation a plus) in bacterial hosts; analyze MS data, collaborate.

Postdoctoral Researcher, History, Culture and Communication Studies 3-year postdoc to lead independent research on 21st‑century propaganda in Northern Europe; publish articles/monograph, collaborate in SafeEarth, seek funding, minimal teaching.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Neuromodulation of Feeding Postdoc to study neuropeptide control of feeding in Drosophila using genetics/CRISPR, imaging & bioinformatics. Lead papers, supervise students. 1-year extendable.

Scientific Programmer / Post-Doctoral Researcher on Project Hippocampus: The Future of OpenML Redesign and build next-gen OpenML: develop elegant APIs and user-centered/agentic interfaces, integrate with federated data/compute platforms, improve maintainability and review OSS code. ML/web stack exp.

Full-time one-year postdoctotal position at the centre de Recherche en philosophie 12‑month postdoc: propose your own project on 18th‑century philosophy engaging Newton’s mathematical‑experimental paradigm (RENEW18). International mobility required; research budget & benefits.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Experimental Neurodegeneration Lead iPSC-derived midbrain neuron/organoid studies in neurodegeneration; perturb Ca2+/mitochondria pathways, imaging/MEA, multiomics. 3‑yr full-time Belval; €87,306/yr.

Postdoc in Metabolomics & Lipidomics - Core Facility Postdoc supporting metabolomics/lipidomics core facility: run LC/IC/GC‑MS assays, develop/validate methods, analyse data, ensure QA, support clients. 24‑month, Belval.
